newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares ease, pulled down by Kolinska.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares ease, pulled down by Kolinska.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 0.68 percent on Monday, pulled down by food producer Kolinska after the group listed a batch of new shares, traders said.

They added the key SBI index could fall to about 1,250 points by the end of the week unless new investors appeared on the horizon. "Without fresh investment, the index could fall by about 50 points until the end of the week," said one.
* The SBI index fell 8.94 points to 1,307.62.
* Kolinska, which listed 650,977 new shares on Monday, fell 3.54 percent to 1,910 tolars on volume of 6,744 shares.

* Petrol trader Petrol, which was listed on Monday but is not included in the blue-chip index, was most actively traded, ending the day at 17,140 tolars after opening at 18,000, on volume of 1,987 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
